title: Pāʻia Sugar Mill light industrial rezoning
summary: Bills 109 and 115 would change the Pāʻia Sugar Mill land from Heavy Industrial and Urban Reserve to Light Industrial, with owners saying current zoning blocks food processing and cold storage. The committee removed uses like B&Bs and added water-saving, evacuation route and chain business conditions, with final wording due when the bills return for first reading.

timeline.text: The owners said 20% open space, about four acres, is a big burden.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Amendment to require at least 20% of the property to remain in open space: The vote on this amendment is not in the recording.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Seven members voted aye to add those three conditions.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Staff will have final wording for the new conditions when the bills come back for first reading.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Members reviewed conditions on water-saving practices, an evacuation route, and chain businesses.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Seven members voted aye on that amendment.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: The open space amendment passed with seven ayes.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: One amendment removed uses such as bed-and-breakfasts, animal kennels, and car lots.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Members voted six to one to count the evacuation route as open space.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: The applicant said the 20 percent rule is a burden on the project.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: The owners said current zoning keeps them from building a food processing center and cold storage.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Members discussed banning chain businesses, called formula businesses.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Members discussed a condition requiring water-saving practices, enforced by the Department of Water Supply.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: This amendment passed with seven ayes and two members excused.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Homes must be in the same building as a business or other non-home use.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Live-work units, with a shop below and a home above, would be allowed.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Under the proposed M1 zoning, the owners could build apartments but not single-family homes.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: A member said that after the fire, people were moved around a lot, so B&B space could serve as temporary housing in a disaster.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Bed-and-breakfasts would not be allowed, except for temporary humanitarian housing in a disaster.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: The chair proposed using the M1 light industrial zoning uses, minus some uses.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Managing partners of the Pāʻia Village Company, which owns the land, began a presentation.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Bill 109 would change the community plan use (the long-range land plan) for one 2.5-acre parcel from Heavy Industrial to Light Industrial.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Spence told a councilmember the community plan never tied the mill and the Pāʻia bypass together.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: He said the Council always meant for the site to have industrial and business uses.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Spence said he was a staff planner in 1995 when the Council adopted the Pāʻia-Haʻikū community plan.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Bill 115 would rezone the land from Urban Reserve to M1 Light Industrial.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: The main item was Bills 109 and 115 for the Pāʻia Sugar Mill redevelopment project.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: Referral of Bill 109 (2026): Bill 109, on the Pāʻia Sugar Mill Redevelopment Project, was sent to the Housing and Land Use Committee.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting
